selected_embedding.query_requirement: The caller supplies one finite L2-normalized E5 query vector. Encoding, model loading, and answer generation are outside this task.

entry_boundary.entrypoint: An explicitly enabled user chat only; this task exposes no HTTP route and starts no worker.
entry_boundary.ordinary_search: M4 deterministic documentation search is neither imported nor called, changed, ranked against, or made dependent on this retriever.
entry_boundary.external_evidence: disabled and absent from this retriever

locale_and_filtering.locale_rule: One request scans exactly the requested active locale. Cross-locale merge, fallback, and retry are forbidden.
locale_and_filtering.version_rule: Every candidate must match the caller's current BPM and documentation version; a stale or mixed generation is unavailable rather than partially queried.
locale_and_filtering.guide_rule: An optional exact guide-id allowlist filters only candidates in the active locale.
locale_and_filtering.ranking: Descending dot product over verified L2-normalized float32 vectors; equal scores break by stable chunk_id ascending.

evidence_and_citation.citation: Every retained candidate includes source_kind=local, a verified fragment-free /help/{locale}/ topic URL, a separately verified anchor identity when present, and a stable topic citation identity.
evidence_and_citation.no_evidence: An empty candidate set is an explicit retrieval outcome for later abstention or clarification; it never falls back to ordinary search, another locale, generated text, or web evidence.

validate_before_scan: safe active pointer and generation identifier
metadata byte hash/shape/field set/canonical chunk order
integrity_and_recovery.failure: Any missing, symlinked, partial, corrupt, stale, mixed, incompatible, or malformed artifact makes retrieval unavailable; callers must abstain and keep M4 ready.
integrity_and_recovery.diagnostics: Expose only stable retrieval reason codes, never local paths, artifact hashes, chunk text, or raw exceptions.
